summary: No trades. Bankroll $9,889.10 (-1.11%) vs SPY +3.11% — 422bps behind, the worst reading of the experiment, with 125bps of it arriving in three sessions while SPY was flat. The cause is legible and is the tilt alone: since 8/26 NVDA +4.6%, QQQ +0.5%, SPY +0.1%, RSP -1.2%, IJH -1.7%, IWM -1.8%, a clean size gradient, with TLT explaining only ~8bps of the 128bps tracker move — this is breadth, not duration. At 1.9 sigma against a 37-40bps/day residual sd it is not a signal by my pre-registered threshold (-600bps, now -128bps), so I held: cutting the tilt into SPY here is loss-triggered de-risking, which locks in the deficit and leaves a guaranteed loss to the benchmark via the compulsory 5.75% cash sleeve. All guardrails clear — gross 94.25% vs 95%, nearest cap needs +2.41% on RSP, breaker $9,336.30 is 592bps away, day-trades 0/3. Declined energy on oil near $90 (Iran risk) and EIX -24% under pre-registered no-chase conditions; executed the pre-registered narrowing of rule 8 after two runs the scheduler never fired.
